metadata.description: Template profile for a TypeScript project. Replace the seed tasks with your own backlog.

promptProfile:
TypeScript project conventions:
- Use strict TypeScript (no `any`, no `ts-ignore` without a comment explaining why).
- Prefer `const` over `let`; avoid mutation where practical.
- All new exports must be typed explicitly — no inferred `any` from external sources.
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and verify it passes before committing.

seed.title: scaffold: set up TypeScript project with tsconfig.json, src/ directory, and build/typecheck scripts in package.json
